#  'Participation_y': string, 'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing': integer, 'Math_y': integer, 'Total': integer]

# Rename df0 columns to match target suffixes for source 0
df0_renamed = df0.rename(columns={
    'Participation': 'Participation_x',
    'Math': 'Math_x'
})

# Rename df1 columns to match target suffixes for source 1
df1_renamed = df1.rename(columns={
    'Participation': 'Participation_y',
    'Math': 'Math_y'
})

# Join on 'State' column (inner join to keep only states present in both sources)
df_merged = pd.merge(df0_renamed, df1_renamed, on='State', how='inner')

# Reorder and select columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'State',
    'Participation_x',
    'English',
    'Math_x',
    'Reading',
    'Science',
    'Composite',
    'Participation_y',
    'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing',
    'Math_y',
    'Total'
]

df_target = df_merged[target_columns]

# Convert data types to match target schema:
# 'State': string (already string)
# 'Participation_x': string (e.g. '93%')
# 'English': float
# 'Math_x': float
# 'Reading': float
# 'Science': float
# 'Composite': float
# 'Participation_y': string (e.g. '9%')
# 'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing': integer
# 'Math_y': integer
# 'Total': integer

# Convert columns accordingly
float_cols = ['English', 'Math_x', 'Reading', 'Science', 'Composite']
int_cols = ['Evidence-Based Reading and Writing', 'Math_y', 'Total']

for col in float_cols:
    df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce')

for col in int_cols:
    df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# Participation columns are strings with percentages, keep as is (string)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_33/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
